## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Choice. For complexes of vector spaces over a field $k$ with finite diagonals, cross product is a natural isomorphism $\bigoplus_{p+q=n}H_pC\otimes_kH_qD\cong H_n(C\otimes_kD)$.
